speaker: Doctor
text:
That sounds like a classic sciatic distribution. Did you notice any recent trauma to your back, or was this strictly exercise-related? Also, have you noticed any changes in bowel or bladder control, or numbness in the saddle area?

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: L5-S1 Lumbar Disc Herniation. The MRI confirms a herniated disc at L5-S1 impinging the nerve root, which explains your radiating pain and onset during exercise. I recommend rest, anti-inflammatory medication, and physical therapy; please return immediately if you experience worsening weakness or bowel/bladder changes.
